sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内的血也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了心思来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查清了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: At around 10pm on Thursday January 16, 1997, Gregory Coons was watching the late night news at his home in Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 1997年1月16日星期四晚上10点左右，格雷戈里·孔斯正坐在亚利桑那州菲尼克斯市的家中看深夜新闻。

sentences.en: After 10 or so minutes, he turned the television off and headed to bed, where his girlfriend Stephanie lay awake, looking obviously concerned.
sentences.zh: 大约十分钟后，他关掉电视准备上床睡觉。他的女友斯蒂芬妮正醒着躺在那儿，神情明显十分担忧。

sentences.en: Moments earlier, she had heard what sounded like a woman outside screaming,
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟前，她听到屋外似乎有女人在尖叫，

sentences.en: Please no, or please don't.
sentences.zh: “求求你不要”或“求求你别这样”。

sentences.en: The screams had since subsided, giving way to the faint sounds of someone moaning or crying.
sentences.zh: 尖叫声随后平息了下去，取而代之的是微弱的呻吟声或哭泣声。

sentences.en: Years of working in construction had damaged Gregory's hearing, and while he hadn't heard anything unusual himself, he still felt compelled to check if everything was alright.
sentences.zh: 多年的建筑工作损害了格雷戈里的听力，虽然他自己并没有听到什么异常，但他还是觉得有必要去查看一下是否一切安好。

sentences.en: After stepping out onto his back patio and listening closely, he soon heard the strange noise Stephanie had described.
sentences.zh: 当他走到后露台并仔细倾听时，他很快听到了斯蒂芬妮所描述的那种奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: It was coming from the other side of the tall, grey, cinderblock fence that separated his yard from that of his next-door neighbours, the Falata family.
sentences.zh: 声音来自那堵高大的灰色煤渣砖墙的另一侧，那堵墙将他的院子与隔壁邻居法拉塔一家的院子隔开。

sentences.en: At first, Gregory Coons thought the noises might be a couple having sex, but with the six-foot-high fence blocking his view, he couldn't be sure.
sentences.zh: 起初，格雷戈里·孔斯以为这些声音可能是一对情侣在做爱，但由于六英尺高的栅栏挡住了视线，他无法确定。

sentences.en: He went into his garage, quietly opened an exterior door closer to the fence, and listened again, only to realise the moaning had stopped.
sentences.zh: 他走进车库，悄悄打开了一扇靠近栅栏的外门，再次侧耳倾听，却发现呻吟声已经停止了。

sentences.en: Then, he heard the sound of footsteps crunching along the gravel path that lined the Falata's side of the fence.
sentences.zh: 接着，他听到沿着法拉塔家那一侧栅栏的砾石小路上传来踩碎石头的脚步声。

sentences.en: Driven by curiosity, Gregory silently crept to a flower planter at the rear of his backyard.
sentences.zh: 在好奇心的驱使下，格雷戈里悄悄溜向后院后面的一个花盆。

sentences.en: He stepped onto the railroad tyres that held the planter together, giving him just enough height to peer discreetly over the fence.
sentences.zh: 他踩在固定花盆的铁路旧轮胎上，这让他的高度刚刚好，可以隐蔽地越过栅栏张望。

sentences.en: The Falata property featured a two-storey stucco home in a warm, cream colour that occupied most of the lot.
sentences.zh: 法拉塔家的房产是一栋双层灰泥住宅，呈温暖的米色，占据了大部分地块。

sentences.en: Their backyard, like Gregory's, was compact and fully enclosed.
sentences.zh: 他们的后院和格雷戈里的一样，面积紧凑且完全封闭。

sentences.en: It had a cosy patio, a towering pine tree, and a small, curved swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个舒适的露台、一棵高耸的松树和一个小型弧形游泳池。

sentences.en: Though the Falata's yard was unlit, Gregory could make out a figure writhing on the ground near the pool.
sentences.zh: 虽然法拉塔家的院子没有开灯，但格雷戈里隐约辨认出一个身影正在泳池旁的地上一边扭动一边翻滚。

sentences.en: It was a fully clothed woman.
sentences.zh: 那是一个穿着完整衣服的女人。

sentences.en: She lay with her head facing the house and her feet pointing towards the pool pump equipment.
sentences.zh: 她躺着，头部朝向房子，双脚指向泳池水泵设备。

sentences.en: She sluggishly shifted onto her left side, draped her right arm over her head, moved her legs slightly, then rolled onto her back again.
sentences.zh: 她动作迟缓地翻向左侧，将右臂搭在头上，双腿稍微动了动，接着又仰面躺平。

sentences.en: Her slow, uncoordinated movements led Gregory to suspect she was heavily intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 她缓慢而不协调的动作让格雷戈里怀疑她严重醉酒。

sentences.en: Glancing toward the Falata's house, Gregory noticed multiple lights on inside, including one in the downstairs kitchen and another in the garage.
sentences.zh: 朝法拉塔家望去，格雷戈里注意到里面亮着好几盏灯，包括楼下厨房的一盏和车库的另一盏。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a light flicked on in an upstairs bedroom.
sentences.zh: 突然，楼上一间卧室的灯亮了。

sentences.en: The window's blinds were open, giving Gregory a clear view inside.
sentences.zh: 窗户的百叶窗开着，让格雷戈里能清晰地看到里面。

sentences.en: A man wearing a white t-shirt and red flannel sweatpants walked past the window and into an adjoining bathroom, where he turned on another light.
sentences.zh: 一个穿着白色 T 恤和红色法兰绒运动裤的男人从窗前走过，进入一间相连的浴室，并在那里打开了另一盏灯。

sentences.en: Even though the bathroom window was frosted, Gregory could see the man's silhouette as he moved about.
sentences.zh: 尽管浴室的窗户是磨砂的，但格雷戈里还是能看到那个男人走动时的剪影。

sentences.en: It was 43-year-old Scott Falata, the family's husband and father.
sentences.zh: 那是43岁的斯科特·法拉塔，这个家庭的丈夫和父亲。

sentences.en: Scott moved in and out of sight before switching off both the bathroom and bedroom lights, then disappeared entirely.
sentences.zh: 斯科特在视线中时隐时现，随后关掉了浴室和卧室的灯，接着彻底消失了。

sentences.en: Moments later, Gregory spotted him again.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，格雷戈里又发现了他的踪迹。

sentences.en: Now he was downstairs near a sliding glass door that opened out to the patio.
sentences.zh: 此时他在楼下，靠近通往露台的推拉玻璃门。

sentences.en: Through the surrounding windows, Gregory watched Scott move from the kitchen to the living room, appearing to wring his hands as if he had just washed them.
sentences.zh: 透过周围的窗户，格雷戈里看着斯科特从厨房走到客厅，看起来像是在绞着双手，仿佛他刚洗过手一样。

sentences.en: He then started towards the staircase leading back upstairs, but abruptly changed direction to enter another room instead.
sentences.zh: 接着他开始走向通往楼上的楼梯，却突然改变方向走进了另一间屋子。

sentences.en: He reappeared at the patio door again a short while later.
sentences.zh: 不久后，他又出现在露台门边。

sentences.en: Scott slid open the door and stepped outside.
sentences.zh: 斯科特拉开门走了出去。

sentences.en: One of the family's two pet dogs approached him and he motioned to them to lie down.
sentences.zh: 家里养的两只宠物狗之一向他走来，他做手势示意它们趴下。

sentences.en: They obeyed as he moved towards the woman lying near the pool.
sentences.zh: 当他走向躺在泳池旁的那个女人时，它们听话地照做了。

sentences.en: By now, Gregory had deduced that the woman was Scott's wife, 41-year-old Yamala Falata.
sentences.zh: 此刻，格雷戈里已经断定那个女人是斯科特的妻子、41岁的亚马拉·法拉塔。

sentences.en: The situation was undeniably strange, but he hesitated to jump to conclusions.
sentences.zh: 这情况无疑十分诡异，但他犹豫着不敢妄下结论。

sentences.en: The Falatars had always been good, peaceful neighbours, well-liked within their community and known for their pious and pleasant nature.
sentences.zh: 法拉塔一家一直都是善良、平和的邻居，在社区里很受欢迎，以虔诚和友善的性格闻名。

sentences.en: Nothing about them had ever suggested trouble.
sentences.zh: 他们身上从未有过任何迹象表明会有麻烦。

sentences.en: Yet, something about Scott's demeanour was deeply unsettling.
sentences.zh: 然而，斯科特的神态中却有着某种令人极其不安的东西。

sentences.en: He stopped at just a few feet from Yamala and stood completely still while staring down at her in silence.
sentences.zh: 他在离亚马拉只有几英尺远的地方停下，一动不动地站在那里，默默地俯视着她。

sentences.en: It was as if he was lost in thought, contemplating his next move.
sentences.zh: 那样子仿佛他陷入了沉思，在盘算着下一步的行动。

sentences.en: Time stretched uncomfortably by.
sentences.zh: 时间在令人难受的沉默中流逝。

sentences.en: Then, without a word, Scott turned and walked back toward the house.
sentences.zh: 接着，一言不发地，斯科特转身走回了屋里。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a noise rang out near Gregory.
sentences.zh: 突然，格雷戈里附近响起了一个声音。

sentences.en: He hadn't made it, but Scott heard it.
sentences.zh: 不是他弄出来的，但斯科特听到了。

sentences.en: His head snapped in Gregory's direction, scanning the darkness.
sentences.zh: 他的头猛地转向格雷戈里这一边，扫视着黑暗。

sentences.en: Gregory froze, holding his breath, afraid he'd been caught spying.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里僵住了，屏住呼吸，生怕自己偷窥的事情被发现。

sentences.en: A tense moment passed before Scott finally turned away and had disappeared through the sliding door, seemingly unaware of Gregory's presence.
sentences.zh: 紧张的时刻过去了，斯科特终于转过身，从推拉门消失了，似乎并没有察觉到格雷戈里的存在。

sentences.en: The next time Gregory saw Scott, he was emerging from the garage.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里再次见到斯科特时，他正从车库里走出来。

sentences.en: He wore a glove on one hand and was slipping the matching on as he walked along their shared fence.
sentences.zh: 他一只手上戴着手套，沿着他们共用的栅栏走着时，正把另一只配套的手套戴上。

sentences.en: Upon reaching Yamala once more, he stepped over her, grabbed her by the wrists, and pulled her arms over her head.
sentences.zh: 再次走到亚马拉身旁时，他跨过她的身体，抓住她的手腕，把她的胳膊拉过头顶。

sentences.en: He then began dragging her backward toward the pool.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始把她往后拖向泳池。

sentences.en: At the water's edge, Scott laid Yamala's arms down, walked around her, lifted her legs, and dropped them into the shallow end of the pool.
sentences.zh: 在水边，斯科特放下亚马拉的胳膊，绕到她身旁，抬起她的双腿，把它们扔进了泳池的浅水区。

sentences.en: Gregory struggled to make sense of what he was witnessing.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里努力想要理解他眼前所目睹的一切。

sentences.en: Scott knelt beside Yamala, pushed her entire body into the water, and leaned over her.
sentences.zh: 斯科特跪在亚马拉身旁，把她的整个身体推进水里，然后俯身压在她身上。

sentences.en: At first, it seemed as though Scott was splashing Yamala's face to wake her from a drunken stupor.
sentences.zh: 起初，看起来斯科特好像是在往亚马拉脸上泼水，想把她从酒醉的昏迷中唤醒。

sentences.en: But as Gregory watched on, the truth became far more sinister.
sentences.zh: 但随着格雷戈里继续观看，真相变得阴险恐怖得多。

sentences.en: Scott wasn't trying to help Yamala.
sentences.zh: 斯科特根本不是在试图帮助亚马拉。

sentences.en: He was forcibly holding her head underwater.
sentences.zh: 他在强行把她的头按在水下。

sentences.en: Gregory jumped down from his vantage point and ran inside his house.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里从他的观察点跳下来，跑进了屋里。

sentences.en: Oh my god, he put her head underwater, he blurted to his girlfriend, Stephanie, before calling 911.
sentences.zh: “噢天哪，他把她的头按进水里了，”他冲着女友斯蒂芬妮脱口而出，随后拨打了 911。

sentences.en: When the dispatcher asked about the unfolding emergency, Gregory struggled to process what he had just seen.
sentences.zh: 当调度员询问正在发生的紧急情况时，格雷戈里很难理清他刚刚看到的一切。

sentences.en: I don't know, he said breathlessly.
sentences.zh: “我不知道，”他气喘吁吁地说。

sentences.en: My neighbours, there was a bunch of yelling and screaming going on.
sentences.zh: “我的邻居，那里有一群人在大喊大叫。”

sentences.en: I looked over the fence, and the husband just threw, I believe the wife, into the pool, and it looks like he's holding her underwater.
sentences.zh: “我往栅栏那边看，那个丈夫刚把，我觉着是把妻子扔进了泳池，而且看起来他正把她的头按在水下。”

sentences.en: After the call, Gregory rushed back outside to check on the fellators.
sentences.zh: 挂断电话后，格雷戈里急忙跑回室外去查看法拉塔一家的状况。

sentences.en: Yarmala was now floating face down in the pool.
sentences.zh: 雅尔玛拉此时正脸朝下漂浮在泳池中。

sentences.en: Scott was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 斯科特不见踪影。

sentences.en: Gregory called 911 again, emphasising the urgency of the situation.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里再次拨打 911，强调情况的紧急性。

sentences.en: Within minutes, officers arrived at his house, swiftly scaled the block fence, and dropped into the fellators' backyard.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，警员们赶到他家，迅速翻过砖墙，跳进了法拉塔家的后院。

sentences.en: Tensions ran high.
sentences.zh: 气氛高度紧张。

sentences.en: They had no idea where Scott Felata was or what level of danger he posed.
sentences.zh: 他们完全不知道斯科特·费拉塔在哪里，也不知道他构成了多大程度的危险。

sentences.en: Was he inside the house, armed and waiting?
sentences.zh: 他是不是拿着武器正藏在屋里等待？

sentences.en: In the pool lay a gruesome sight.
sentences.zh: 泳池里躺着一幅骇人的景象。

sentences.en: The faint glow of a motion sensor light dimly illuminated Yarmala Felata's motionless body, the water around her tinged with a faint pink hue.
sentences.zh: 感应灯微弱的光线隐约照亮了雅尔玛拉·费拉塔一动不动躯体，她周围的水被染成了一层淡淡的粉红色。

sentences.en: The moment an officer pulled her out to begin resuscitation efforts, the water darkened, swirling into a deep red.
sentences.zh: 就在一名警员将她拉出来开始实施心肺复苏时，水变暗了，盘旋成深红色。

sentences.en: It was then that the full horror of the scene became clear.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，现场的全部恐怖之处才显现出来。

sentences.en: Yarmala's body was riddled with dozens of open wounds, her blood transforming the pool into what officers would later compare to the aftermath of a shark attack.
sentences.zh: 雅尔玛拉的尸体布满了数十个开放性创口，她的血将泳池染成了警员们后来比作遭受鲨鱼袭击后的惨状。

sentences.en: An autopsy later confirmed that Yarmala had been stabbed 44 times with a hunting knife.
sentences.zh: 随后的尸检证实雅尔玛拉身上有44处刀伤，是由一把猎刀造成的。

sentences.en: She suffered multiple wounds to her face, neck, breasts, torso, and back, most of which were deemed defensive.
sentences.zh: 她的面部、颈部、胸部、躯干和背部遭受了多处创伤，其中大部分被认定为防御性伤口。

sentences.en: The blade had pierced her lungs, heart, spleen, spinal cord, and jugular vein.
sentences.zh: 刀刃刺穿了她的肺部、心脏、脾脏、脊髓和颈静脉。

sentences.en: The deepest wounds spanned the full five and a half inch length of the blade.
sentences.zh: 最深的伤口横跨了长达五英寸半的整个刀刃长度。

sentences.en: Several of her ribs and vertebrae were also fractured.
sentences.zh: 她的几根肋骨和脊椎骨也骨折了。

sentences.en: Her hands and fingers bore 12 deep cuts, evidence of a desperate struggle.
sentences.zh: 她的双手和手指上有12处很深的切口，这是激烈搏斗的证据。

sentences.en: She had tried to grab the knife during the attack, nearly severing her ring finger in the process.
sentences.zh: 她在袭击过程中曾试图抓住这把刀，在这个过程中险些把无名指切断。

sentences.en: The exact sequence of the injuries remained unclear, as did the total number of times the knife had been thrust at Yarmala.
sentences.zh: 受伤的确切顺序尚不清楚，刺向雅尔玛拉的总次数也不得而知。

sentences.en: The medical examiner determined she had died from massive blood loss and estimated she could have survived upwards of 30 minutes after the attack commenced.
sentences.zh: 法医判定她死于大量失血，并估计她在袭击开始后可能存活了长达30分钟以上。

sentences.en: A key point of contention among experts was whether Yarmala was already deceased when she was pushed into the pool.
sentences.zh: 专家们争论的一个关键点是，雅尔玛拉被推入泳池时是否已经死亡。

sentences.en: Whatever the case, her official cause of death was listed as multiple stab wounds with drowning.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，她的官方死因被列为多处刀伤伴随溺水。

sentences.en: As the first responders processed the grim scene, one of them noticed movement inside the Felata's house.
sentences.zh: 当急救人员处理这个阴森的现场时，其中一人注意到费拉塔家里面有动静。

sentences.en: Scott Felata's silhouette appeared at an upstairs window, before vanishing again.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·费拉塔的身影出现在楼上的窗户前，随后又消失了。

sentences.en: Guns drawn, officers advanced toward the patio, where they found the sliding glass door partially open.
sentences.zh: 警员们拔出枪，朝露台推进，发现推拉玻璃门半开着。

sentences.en: They entered cautiously.
sentences.zh: 他们小心翼翼地走了进去。

sentences.en: The house was silent, save for the low hum of an unwatched television in the living room.
sentences.zh: 屋里一片寂静，只有客厅里一台无人观看的电视机发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Scott appeared at the top of the staircase inside.
sentences.zh: 突然，斯科特出现在里面的楼梯顶端。

sentences.en: It didn't look like he had been involved in a violent altercation recently.
sentences.zh: 他看起来并不像刚刚卷入了一场暴力冲突。

sentences.en: His white t-shirt and red flannel sweatpants were spotless and an expression of pure confusion was painted across his face.
sentences.zh: 他的白色 T 恤和红色法兰绒运动裤一尘不染，脸上挂着一副极度困惑的表情。

sentences.en: The officers kept their guns trained on Scott, barking at him to shut up, show his hands and to get on the ground.
sentences.zh: 警员们用枪指着斯科特，大声命令他闭嘴、把手露出来并趴到地上。

sentences.en: He hesitated for a moment before complying and was swiftly handcuffed as he lay prone on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他犹豫了一会儿才照办，在趴倒在地上时迅速被戴上了手铐。

sentences.en: His demeanour was dazed yet eerily calm, as if he was completely detached from the chaos around him.
sentences.zh: 他的神态茫然却又诡异地平静，仿佛与周围的混乱完全脱节。

sentences.en: To some, he looked as though he had just woken up.
sentences.zh: 在某些人看来，他看起来就像刚醒来一样。

sentences.en: He kept asking, what's going on, over and over, and repeatedly inquired as to his wife's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 他不停地问“怎么了”，一遍又一遍，并反复打听他妻子的下落。

sentences.en: No one told him that Yamala lay dead in the backyard, but with the flurry of police activity,
sentences.zh: 没有人告诉他亚马拉已经死在了后院，但随着警方的频繁活动，

sentences.en: Scott began to piece together that something terrible had happened.
sentences.zh: 斯科特开始拼凑出发生了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: He urged the officers to search for whoever was responsible, expressing concern that the perpetrator might still be inside the house.
sentences.zh: 他敦促警员们搜寻究竟是谁干的，并表达了担心凶手可能还在屋里的顾虑。

sentences.en: But the police weren't buying Scott's innocent act.
sentences.zh: 但警方可不买账斯科特无辜的把戏。

sentences.en: Little did he know, his neighbour Gregory Coons had witnessed him drowning Yamala in the pool moments before they arrived.
sentences.zh: 他并不知道，就在他们到达前不久，他的邻居格雷戈里·孔斯刚目睹了他在泳池里淹死亚马拉。

sentences.en: How many people are in the house, an officer demanded.
sentences.zh: “家里有多少人？”一名警员质问。

sentences.en: Scott's answer caught them off guard.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的回答让他们猝不及防。

sentences.en: Four, he revealed.
sentences.zh: “四个，”他透露道。

sentences.en: Himself, his wife, and their two children.
sentences.zh: 他自己、他妻子，还有他们两个孩子。

sentences.en: Concerns surged for the welfare of the Felader's 15-year-old daughter, Megan, and 12-year-old son, Michael.
sentences.zh: 人们开始为费拉塔家15岁的女儿梅根和12岁的儿子迈周的安全感到担忧。

sentences.en: Officers swept through the home and, to their relief, found the siblings in their respective bedrooms, unharmed and fast asleep.
sentences.zh: 警员们搜查了整栋房屋，令他们宽慰的是，兄妹俩分别安然无恙地在各自的卧室里酣睡。

sentences.en: Megan and Michael had no idea of the horror that had unfolded at their home that night.
sentences.zh: 梅根和迈克根本不知道那天晚上在他们家发生的恐怖事件。

sentences.en: Upon waking the pair, officers initially told them that their parents had gotten into a fight and something bad had happened.
sentences.zh: 警员们在叫醒这两人时，最初告诉他们父母吵了一架，发生了不好的事情。

sentences.en: The siblings immediately found this strange.
sentences.zh: 兄妹俩立刻觉得这很奇怪。

sentences.en: They had never seen their parents argue, let alone fight.
sentences.zh: 他们从未见过父母争吵，更别提打架了。

sentences.en: As they were escorted from the house, they were given the devastating news that their mother was dead.
sentences.zh: 当他们被护送出家门时，得到了母亲已经身亡的噩耗。

sentences.en: In an interview years later with ABC's 2020, Michael Felader recalled that moment tearfully.
sentences.zh: 几年后，迈克·费拉塔在接受美国广播公司（ABC）《20/20》节目采访时，含泪回忆了那一刻。

sentences.en: I went to bed as a 12-year-old kid with a happy life and I woke up to a police officer telling me that my mother died and it's everything you think it would be, and more.
sentences.zh: “我上床睡觉时是个过着幸福生活的12岁孩子，醒来时却听到警务人员告诉我母亲去世了，这一切正如你所想象的那样糟，甚至更糟。”

sentences.en: Scott Felader was taken into custody as investigators began searching the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·费拉塔被拘留，调查人员开始搜查犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Aside from some bloodstains splattered throughout the house and garage, everything appeared relatively normal, with no signs of a struggle.
sentences.zh: 除了整栋房子和车库里溅落的一些血迹外，一切看起来都相对正常，没有打斗的迹象。

sentences.en: In the backyard, a large flashlight illuminated the pool pump equipment and the surrounding ground was stained with blood.
sentences.zh: 在后院，一盏大强光手电筒照亮了泳池水泵设备，周围的地面上沾满了血迹。

sentences.en: The police collected the flashlight, as well as a few bloody gravel stones and eyeglasses with bloodstains.
sentences.zh: 警方收缴了手电筒，以及一些带血的碎石子和带有血迹的眼镜。

sentences.en: However, the most significant discovery lay in the garage.
sentences.zh: 然而，最重要的发现在车库里。

sentences.en: Through the window of Scott's white Volvo hatchback, investigators spotted a bloody white T-shirt in the rear cargo area.
sentences.zh: 透过斯科特白色沃尔沃两厢车的车窗，调查人员在后行李箱区域发现了一件带血的白色 T 恤。

sentences.en: A search of the vehicle uncovered blue jeans, a denim jacket with a small Swiss Army knife in the pocket, and white socks.
sentences.zh: 对车辆的搜查发现了一条蓝色牛仔裤、一件口袋里装着一把小型瑞士军刀的牛仔夹克以及白色袜子。

sentences.en: Hidden inside the spare tyre compartment was a black trash bag and a large, clear plastic container.
sentences.zh: 藏在备胎舱里的是一个黑色垃圾袋和一个大型透明塑料容器。

sentences.en: The trash bag contained a pair of black leather gloves and brown leather hiking boots.
sentences.zh: 垃圾袋里装着一双黑色皮手套和棕色皮质登山靴。

sentences.en: The plastic container, typically used to store food, held the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 这个通常用于储存食物的塑料容器里装着凶器。

sentences.en: All the items were stained with varying amounts of Yamala's blood.
sentences.zh: 所有物品上都沾有不同分量的亚马拉的血迹。

sentences.en: Shortly before 2am, Scott Felader was led into an interrogation room at the Phoenix Police Department to be formally interviewed by a veteran homicide detective, John Norman.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点前不久，斯科特·费拉塔被带进菲尼克斯警察局的审讯室，由资深凶杀案侦探约翰·诺曼进行正式讯问。

sentences.en: He sat barefoot and hunched in a chair pressed into the corner, still wearing his pyjamas and handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 他光着脚，驼着背坐在角落里的一把椅子上，依然穿着睡衣，戴着手铐。

sentences.en: Though no one had explicitly told him Yamala's fate, he stated that he assumed she was dead after noticing the homicide division signage around.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有人明确告诉过他亚马拉的命运，但他在注意到四周有凶杀案调查组的标牌后，表示自己猜到她已经死了。

sentences.en: Detective Norman confirmed,
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探证实道：

sentences.en: Yes, she is.
sentences.zh: 是的，她确实死了。

sentences.en: Obviously you think I did it, Scott replied flatly.
sentences.zh: “显然你们觉得是我干的，”斯科特平静地回答。

sentences.en: After a pause, he added,
sentences.zh: 停顿了一下，他补充道：

sentences.en: I don't know what makes you think that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是什么让你们这么想。

sentences.en: Detective Norman informed Scott that there was a witness who had seen what happened.
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探告诉斯科特，有一位目击者看到了发生的一切。

sentences.en: Jeez, Scott said coolly.
sentences.zh: “天哪，”斯科特冷冷地说。

sentences.en: As the details of Gregory Coon's account were laid out before him, Scott maintained his demeanour of disbelief.
sentences.zh: 随着格雷戈里·库恩的陈述细节在他面前展开，斯科特依然保持着难以置信的态度。

sentences.en: He asked with a hint of scepticism in his voice.
sentences.zh: 他带着一丝怀疑的语气问道。

sentences.en: Neighbours saw me pushing her into the pool.
sentences.zh: 邻居们看到我把她推进了泳池。

sentences.en: Detective Norman said,
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探说：

sentences.en: Well, actually, there was a lot more described than that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上，描述的内容远不止这些。

sentences.en: Scott retorted,
sentences.zh: 斯科特反驳道：

sentences.en: You've got to be kidding.
sentences.zh: 你一定是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Detective Norman replied firmly,
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探坚定地回答：

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: To police, there was no doubt that Scott had killed his wife.
sentences.zh: 对警方来说，毫无疑问是斯科特杀害了他的妻子。

sentences.en: Yet, it was clear from the outset that he wasn't a typical murder suspect.
sentences.zh: 然而，从一开始就很明显，他并不是一个典型的谋杀嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Unlike most suspects who would vehemently deny the allegations, offer a staunch defence, or demand a lawyer,
sentences.zh: 与大多数会极力否认指控、进行坚决辩护或要求找律师的嫌疑人不同，

sentences.en: Scott meekly accepted everything Detective Norman asserted had happened regarding Yamala's death.
sentences.zh: 斯科特温顺地接受了诺曼警探关于亚马拉之死所断言的一切。

sentences.en: His only response was to apologise and repeat that he didn't remember anything.
sentences.zh: 他唯一的反应就是道歉，并反复说自己什么都不记得了。

sentences.en: He offered no explanation as to why, just that he couldn't.
sentences.zh: 他没有解释原因，只说自己记不起来了。

sentences.en: Scott did recall the events leading up to it, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，斯科特确实还记得此前发生的那些事。

sentences.en: After a day at work, he returned home and went upstairs to change into a t-shirt and jeans.
sentences.zh: 下班后，他回家上楼换上了一件T恤和牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Yamala had dinner ready, so the family sat at the dining table together.
sentences.zh: 亚马拉已经准备好了晚餐，于是全家人一起坐在餐桌旁。

sentences.en: According to the Felata children, their dinner conversation was normal, with nothing seeming out of the ordinary between their parents.
sentences.zh: 据费拉塔家的孩子们所说，他们晚饭时的交谈很正常，父母之间看起来没有任何异样。

sentences.en: However, 12-year-old Michael noted that his father seemed very stressed about a work meeting, and his mother was concerned because the pool pump wasn't working properly.
sentences.zh: 然而，12岁的迈克尔注意到，他的父亲似乎对一次工作会议感到非常压力山大，而他的母亲则因为泳池水泵运转不正常而感到担忧。

sentences.en: After dinner, Yamala went into the living room to watch television.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，亚马拉走进客厅看电视。

sentences.en: Michael remembered seeing his father seated on the couch beside her.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔记得看到父亲坐在她身旁的沙发上。

sentences.en: Sometime between 9 and 9.30pm, Michael went to his room to play video games.
sentences.zh: 在晚上9点到9点半之间的某个时候，迈克尔回房间去玩电子游戏了。

sentences.en: Before he went to sleep that evening, he headed back downstairs to kiss both his parents goodnight.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上睡觉前，他又下楼去亲吻了父母，跟他们道晚安。

sentences.en: He didn't notice any tension between them, nor did he hear any strife before falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 他没有察觉到他们之间有任何紧张气氛，在入睡前也没有听到任何争吵。

sentences.en: 15-year-old Megan Felata's account was similar, though she added a few extra details as she had watched television with her parents until going to bed around 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 15岁的梅根·费拉塔的说法也差不多，不过她补充了一些细节，因为她和父母一起看电视一直看到晚上9点半左右上床睡觉。

sentences.en: She remembered them discussing the broken pool pump, with her father saying he would take care of it.
sentences.zh: 她记得他们在讨论坏了的泳池水泵，父亲说他会处理好的。

sentences.en: Scott then got up to do some work at the family computer nearby.
sentences.zh: 接着斯科特起身去附近家里的电脑前处理一些工作。

sentences.en: Before heading upstairs, Megan kissed her parents and told them she loved them.
sentences.zh: 上楼前，梅根亲吻了父母，并告诉他们她爱他们。

sentences.en: Like her brother, she didn't sense any animosity between them and didn't hear anything worrying that night.
sentences.zh: 和哥哥一样，她没有感觉到他们之间有什么敌意，当晚也没有听到任何令人担忧的声音。

sentences.en: There was no one to verify Scott's version of events once his children had gone to bed.
sentences.zh: 孩子们上床睡觉后，就没有人能证实斯科特的这番说辞了。

sentences.en: According to him, after finishing work on the computer, he went into the garage to fetch a pair of pliers, a screwdriver, and a large flashlight to repair the faulty pool pump.
sentences.zh: 据他所说，在电脑前忙完工作后，他去车库拿了一把钳子、一把螺丝刀和一个大号手电筒，准备去修理那个出故障的泳池水泵。

sentences.en: He then headed outside to inspect the equipment, noticing that a ring on the pump was broken and not sealing properly.
sentences.zh: 然后他走到室外检查设备，发现水泵上的一个环坏了，密封不严。

sentences.en: Scott decided it would be easier to fix it in the daylight after buying a replacement.
sentences.zh: 斯科特觉得买个替换件后在白天修理会更方便。

sentences.en: He put his tools back in the garage and washed his hands before re-entering the house.
sentences.zh: 他把工具放回车库，洗了手，然后重新走进屋里。

sentences.en: He found Yamala sitting upright, asleep on the couch.
sentences.zh: 他发现亚马拉正端坐着在沙发上睡着了。

sentences.en: Gently, Scott woke her and explained that he wouldn't be able to fix the pool pump until the following day.
sentences.zh: 斯科特轻轻地叫醒她，解释说他要到第二天才能修好泳池水泵。

sentences.en: He then kissed her goodnight and went upstairs to bed.
sentences.zh: 接着他吻了她晚安，然后上楼睡觉了。

sentences.en: It was between 9.30 and 10pm.
sentences.zh: 当时在晚上9点半到10点之间。

sentences.en: He was adamant that this was the last time he saw Yamala.
sentences.zh: 他坚信这是他最后一次见到亚马拉。

sentences.en: The next thing he remembered was waking up to the flurry of police activity, at which point his wife was dead.
sentences.zh: 他接下来记得的事，就是在警察的一片忙乱中醒来，而那时他的妻子已经死了。

sentences.en: He maintained that he had no recollection of the events that took place in between.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己对这期间发生的事情毫无记忆。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《档案》节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Unconvinced, Detective John Norman pressed Scott for a motive.
sentences.zh: 约翰·诺曼警探并不买账，他向斯科特逼问动机。

sentences.en: With his face buried in his hands, Scott professed,
sentences.zh: 斯科特把脸埋在双手里，坦白道：

sentences.en: Detective Norman observed Scott's body language, the way he avoided eye contact, sighed deeply, leaned exasperated against the wall,
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探观察着斯科特的肢体语言，他如何避免眼神接触、深深地叹气、精疲力竭地靠在墙上，

sentences.en: and cradled himself curled up in the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 以及像胎儿一样蜷缩着抱着自己。

sentences.en: To Norman, Scott carried himself like a guilt-ridden man.
sentences.zh: 在诺曼看来，斯科特的举止就像一个满心罪恶感的人。

sentences.en: He wasn't at all convinced by Scott's claims of amnesia.
sentences.zh: 他一点也不相信斯科特关于失忆的说辞。

sentences.en: You remember more than that, he insisted.
sentences.zh: “你记得的远不止这些，”他坚持道。

sentences.en: Scott took a deep breath and replied,
sentences.zh: 斯科特深吸了一口气，回答说：

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Scott's clean clothing raised suspicions that he must have showered and changed immediately after stabbing Yamala to conceal evidence.
sentences.zh: 斯科特干净的衣服引起了怀疑，让人觉得他肯定是在刺死亚马拉后立即洗澡并换了衣服来隐瞒证据。

sentences.en: But, as Detective Norman observed, he had missed a spot, a small smear of blood behind his ear.
sentences.zh: 但是，正如诺曼警探所观察到的那样，他漏掉了一个地方，他耳后有一小抹血迹。

sentences.en: Pointing to Scott's ear, Detective Norman asked,
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探指着斯科特的耳朵问：

sentences.en: How'd you get the blood on you?
sentences.zh: 你身上的血是怎么来的？

sentences.en: Scott seemingly feigned ignorance.
sentences.zh: 斯科特似乎在假装不知道。

sentences.en: What blood?
sentences.zh: 什么血？

sentences.en: Detective Norman pushed on.
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探继续追问。

sentences.en: The blood all over your neck.
sentences.zh: 你脖子上的那些血。

sentences.en: Scott reached up, touched his neck, and said,
sentences.zh: 斯科特抬起手摸了摸脖子，说道：

sentences.en: I didn't know there was blood on me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己身上有血。

sentences.en: Detective Norman didn't believe him, but pressed on to another significant discovery.
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探不相信他的话，但随即转向了另一个重大发现。

sentences.en: A freshly applied band-aid covered a small recent wound above Scott's index finger.
sentences.zh: 一个新贴的创可贴覆盖了斯科特食指上方的一个近期小伤口。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for someone wielding a knife during a violent encounter to injure themselves, especially if, as in Yamala's case, the victim had desperately fought back.
sentences.zh: 在暴力冲突中挥舞刀具的人受伤并不罕见，特别是像亚马拉这种情况，受害者曾拼死反抗过。

sentences.en: Detective Norman asked Scott directly,
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探直接问斯科特：

sentences.en: How'd you cut your hand?
sentences.zh: 你的手是怎么割伤的？

sentences.en: Scott hesitated, clearly contemplating his answer.
sentences.zh: 斯科特犹豫了一下，显然在斟酌他的回答。

sentences.en: Detective Norman broke the long silence with a sarcastic jab.
sentences.zh: 诺曼警探用一句讽刺的挖苦打破了长时间的沉默。

sentences.en: Forget that, too.
sentences.zh: 这个你也忘了吗？

sentences.en: Finally, Scott muttered,
sentences.zh: 最后，斯科特嘟囔道：

sentences.en: I don't remember putting that on.
sentences.zh: 我不记得贴过这个东西。

sentences.en: By now, Detective Norman had heard enough.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，诺曼警探已经听够了。

sentences.en: Reflecting on the interrogation for ABC's 2020, he remarked,
sentences.zh: 在为美国广播公司（ABC）的《20/20》节目回顾审讯过程时，他评论道：

sentences.en: The only thing I believed about his story was that his name was Scott for later.
sentences.zh: 关于他的故事，我唯一相信的一点就是他以后叫斯科特。

sentences.en: The brief interview ended without a confession, but the evidence and witness accounts painted a damning picture.
sentences.zh: 这次短暂的讯问在没有获得口供的情况下结束了，但证据和目击者的陈述勾勒出一幅罪证确凿的画面。

sentences.en: Investigators believed Scott confronted Yamala shortly before 10pm.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，斯科特在晚上10点前不久与亚马拉发生了冲突。

sentences.en: Given the lack of blood staining inside the home, the attack likely began in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 鉴于屋内缺乏血迹喷溅，袭击很可能是从后院开始的。

sentences.en: Scott then cleaned himself up, hid the hunting knife and bloodied clothing in his car, and to drown Yamala to ensure she was dead.
sentences.zh: 接着斯科特清理了自己，把猎刀和沾满血迹的衣服藏在车里，并将亚马拉溺水以确保她已死亡。

sentences.en: By leaving her body in the pool, he intended for their children to find her in the morning, allowing him to feign ignorance.
sentences.zh: 通过把她的尸体留在泳池里，他意图让他们的孩子在早晨发现她，从而让他得以假装不知情。

sentences.en: By then, he would have driven under cover of darkness to dispose of the evidence somewhere.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他本可以在夜色的掩护下开车去某个地方处理掉证据。

sentences.en: What he didn't account for was that his neighbour had witnessed part of the assault and alerted the police.
sentences.zh: 他没有料到的是，他的邻居目睹了部分袭击过程并报警了。

sentences.en: As a result, Scott for later was charged with the first degree murder of Yamala.
sentences.zh: 因此，后来的斯科特被指控一级谋杀亚马拉。

sentences.en: He faced the possibility of the death penalty if convicted.
sentences.zh: 如果罪名成立，他将面临死刑的判决。

sentences.en: Scott maintained his innocence while awaiting trial, spending his time in jail formulating theories about Yamala's death.
sentences.zh: 在等待审判期间，斯科特坚称自己无罪，把在监狱里的时间都用来构思关于亚马拉死因的种种假设。

sentences.en: He suggested that he was being framed, that his neighbour Gregory Coons might have been responsible, or that he had unknowingly made an enemy who sought to ruin him.
sentences.zh: 他暗示自己遭到了陷害，他的邻居格雷戈里·库恩可能是罪魁祸首，或者他无意中树敌，招致了想毁掉他的人。

sentences.en: At the same time, investigators searched for a motive.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员在搜寻作案动机。

sentences.en: Scott and Yamala had been high school sweethearts who married soon after graduation.
sentences.zh: 斯科特和亚马拉是高中时的青梅竹马，毕业后不久就结婚了。

sentences.en: They had supported each other through further studies, interstate relocations, and life's challenges, often being each other's only close friend and confidant.
sentences.zh: 他们一路扶持，度过了继续深造、跨州搬迁以及生活中的种种挑战，常常是彼此唯一的挚友和知己。

sentences.en: In Scott's words, Yamala was his emotional lifeline, and her unwavering love and support had earned his lifelong devotion.
sentences.zh: 用斯科特的话说，亚马拉是他的情感救命稻草，她坚定不移的爱与支持赢得了他一生的忠诚。

sentences.en: Humility, kindness, and selflessness defined Yamala.
sentences.zh: 谦逊、善良和无私是亚马拉的代名词。

sentences.en: A trained nurse, she had devoted years to raising her two children before recently returning to work as a preschool teacher's aide.
sentences.zh: 作为一名受过培训的护士，她曾花多年时间抚养两个孩子，最近才重返工作岗位，担任学前班助教。

sentences.en: She planned to become a certified teacher once she completed her qualifications.
sentences.zh: 她计划一旦完成资质认证，就成为一名注册教师。

sentences.en: Outside of work, she enjoyed arts and crafts, particularly basket making.
sentences.zh: 工作之余，她喜欢工艺美术，尤其是编织篮子。

sentences.en: Friends described her as intelligent, witty, and practical.
sentences.zh: 朋友们形容她聪明、机智而且务实。

sentences.en: While her marriage to Scott had its ups and downs, she never spoke ill of him.
sentences.zh: 尽管她与斯科特的婚姻也有起伏，但她从未说过他一句坏话。

sentences.en: In the weeks leading up to her murder, Yamala was in good spirits, showing no signs of distress or fear.
sentences.zh: 在她遇害前的几周里，亚马拉心情很好，没有表现出任何痛苦或恐惧的迹象。

sentences.en: The tragedy occurred just weeks before her 42nd birthday.
sentences.zh: 这场悲剧发生在她的42岁生日的前几周。

sentences.en: Scott's reputation was just as positive.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的声誉同样十分正面。

sentences.en: No one had a bad word to say about him.
sentences.zh: 没有人说过他半句坏话。

sentences.en: He had no criminal record, no history of domestic violence, and no issues with substance abuse.
sentences.zh: 他没有犯罪记录，没有家庭暴力史，也没有药物滥用问题。

sentences.en: Known as a mild-mannered nerd,
sentences.zh: 作为一名温文尔雅的书呆子，

sentences.en: Scott was seen as an earnest and hard-working family man.
sentences.zh: 斯科特被视为一个认真且顾家的好男人。

sentences.en: He built a successful career as an electrical engineer at Motorola, a leading electronics manufacturer, while also dedicating time to teaching daily religious instruction
sentences.zh: 他在领先的电子制造商摩托罗拉公司（Motorola）担任电气工程师，事业有成，同时还抽出时间教授日常宗教教育课程

sentences.en: for high school students as part of his involvement in the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
sentences.zh: 作为他参与耶稣基督后期圣徒教会活动的一部分，对象是高中生。

sentences.en: Though Scott excelled in engineering, he had long-term plans to shift careers, aspiring to follow in Yamala's footsteps by becoming a teacher.
sentences.zh: 尽管斯科特在工程领域表现出色，但他长期以来一直计划转换职业，渴望追随亚马拉的脚步成为一名教师。

sentences.en: The Faladers lived a comfortable upper-middle-class life in a quiet, safe neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 费拉塔一家在一个安静、安全的社区里过着舒适的中上阶层生活。

sentences.en: Their finances were stable and their home life was peaceful.
sentences.zh: 他们的财务状况稳定，家庭生活很平静。

sentences.en: According to their children, Megan and Michael, their upbringing was full of love.
sentences.zh: 据他们的孩子梅根和迈克尔所说，他们的成长环境充满了爱。

sentences.en: The family had no secrets.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭没有任何秘密。

sentences.en: Everyone was open, close and supportive.
sentences.zh: 每个人都坦诚、亲密且相互支持。

sentences.en: Their parents helped with homework, encouraged their hobbies, took them on vacations, and even went caroling together at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母帮忙辅导功课、鼓励他们的爱好、带他们去度假，甚至在圣诞节一起去唱圣歌。

sentences.en: Prior to the events of Thursday January 16 1997,
sentences.zh: 在1997年1月16日星期四的事件发生之前，

sentences.en: Scott and Yamala had been planning a family trip to Europe.
sentences.zh: 斯科特和亚马拉一直计划着一次全家欧洲之行。

sentences.en: Megan and Michael had never seen their parents argue or in conflict.
sentences.zh: 梅根和迈克尔从未见过父母争吵或发生冲突。

sentences.en: They insisted that Scott and Yamala typically saw eye-to-eye, only ever having minor disagreements that were resolved calmly and amicably.
sentences.zh: 他们坚称，斯科特和亚马拉通常意见一致，只会有一些通过冷静和友好方式解决的小分歧。

sentences.en: While Megan had seen her father become angry, she clarified that she had never witnessed him enter a full-blown rage.
sentences.zh: 虽然梅根曾见过父亲生气，但她澄清说，她从未见过他大发雷霆。

sentences.en: Scott and Yamala's relationship was affectionate.
sentences.zh: 斯科特和亚马拉的关系很恩爱。

sentences.en: They frequently kissed, held hands, and went on date nights.
sentences.zh: 他们经常亲吻、手牵手并外出约会。

sentences.en: Friends of the couple echoed this sentiment, describing the Felata's marriage as harmonious and deeply committed.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的朋友也呼应了这种看法，将费拉塔夫妇的婚姻描述为和谐且深情专一。

sentences.en: This made Scott's violent actions all the more baffling.
sentences.zh: 这使得斯科特的暴力行径更加令人费解。

sentences.en: Weeks into his incarceration,
sentences.zh: 入狱几周后，

sentences.en: Scott Felata obtained his case file and studied it, including Gregory Coon's account of Yamala's drowning.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·费拉塔取得了他的案件档案并进行了研读，其中包括格雷戈里·库恩关于亚马拉溺水的陈述。

sentences.en: Scott knew Gregory well and considered him trustworthy.
sentences.zh: 斯科特很了解格雷戈里，并认为他值得信赖。

sentences.en: He couldn't fathom why he would ever fabricate such a story.
sentences.zh: 他无法理解对方为什么会凭空捏造这样一个故事。

sentences.en: At that moment, Scott began to accept that everything being said about him must have been true.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，斯科特开始接受关于他的一切言论一定都是真的这一事实。

sentences.en: He had killed Yamala.
sentences.zh: 他杀害了亚马拉。

sentences.en: Yet, he continued to insist that the reason behind the attack remained a mystery to him.
sentences.zh: 然而，他依然坚称袭击背后的原因对他来说仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: In a jailhouse interview with ABC's 2020,
sentences.zh: 在接受美国广播公司（ABC）《20/20》节目的狱中采访时，

sentences.en: Scott reiterated that he had been hopelessly confused when police arrived at his house that January evening.
sentences.zh: 斯科特重申，当警察在那个一月的傍晚来到他家时，他已经糊涂得无可救药了。

sentences.en: Nothing felt real, and he was certain he hadn't been 100% coherent as he was taken into custody.
sentences.zh: 一切都感觉很不真实，他确信自己在被拘留时并没有百分之百保持清醒。

sentences.en: Even in the interrogation room, he struggled to believe Yamala was truly dead.
sentences.zh: 甚至在审讯室里，他也难以相信亚马拉真的已经死了。

sentences.en: He maintained that he loved his wife and was still trying to make sense of what happened, stating,
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己深爱着妻子，并且仍在努力去理解发生了什么，他说道：

sentences.en: I accept the fact that the neighbour saw me do the physical act.
sentences.zh: 我接受邻居看到我做出了这个物理动作这一事实。

sentences.en: Would I have consciously and intentionally killed Yamala?
sentences.zh: 我会是有意识且故意地杀害亚马拉吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不会。

sentences.en: Despite his growing acceptance of the facts,
sentences.zh: 尽管他对事实的接受度日益增加，

sentences.en: Scott remained adamant that he had no memory of the murder.
sentences.zh: 但斯科特仍然坚决表示自己对这起谋杀案毫无记忆。

sentences.en: He began to question whether something was wrong with his brain, perhaps an undiagnosed tumour was affecting his behaviour, or he had an undetected mental illness.
sentences.zh: 他开始怀疑自己的大脑是不是出了什么问题，也许是未确诊的肿瘤影响了他的行为，或者他患有未被察觉的精神疾病。

sentences.en: The uncertainty prompted Scott's attorney to pursue an insanity defence.
sentences.zh: 这种不确定性促使斯科特的律师寻求以精神失常作为辩护理由。

sentences.en: Scott's loved ones were outraged by this decision, convinced that he was a sane man.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的亲人对这一决定感到愤怒，他们坚信他是一个精神正常的人。

sentences.en: Their belief was reinforced by a state-appointed psychologist who found Scott to be an unusual case, entirely devoid of pathology.
sentences.zh: 一位国家指派的心理学家进一步强化了他们的信念，该心理学家发现斯科特是一个罕见的案例，完全没有任何病理特征。

sentences.en: He exhibited no signs of mental illness that might have explained an intentional act of murder.
sentences.zh: 他没有表现出任何精神疾病的迹象，而这本可以解释一场蓄意的谋杀行为。

sentences.en: Instead, the psychologist noted Scott's admirable qualities, describing him as a non-aggressive thinker who preferred resolving conflicts through discussion rather than violence.
sentences.zh: 相反，心理学家指出了斯科特令人钦佩的品质，将他描述为一个不具攻击性的思考者，倾向于通过讨论而非暴力来解决冲突。

sentences.en: They concluded that Scott deeply loved Yamala and felt genuine remorse for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他们断定斯科特深爱着雅玛拉，并对发生的事情感到由衷的懊悔。

sentences.en: Megan and Michael for later stood by their father, unable to accept that he could have intentionally harmed their mother.
sentences.zh: 梅根和迈克尔后来一直支持他们的父亲，无法接受他会故意伤害他们的母亲。

sentences.en: Scott's mother and siblings felt the same.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的母亲和兄弟姐妹们也有同感。

sentences.en: They spent countless hours dissecting his past, hoping to uncover an explanation for such a shocking, out-of-character act.
sentences.zh: 他们花了无数个小时剖析他的过去，希望能为这种令人震惊、与其性格不符的行为找到一个解释。

sentences.en: Scott's childhood was marked by trauma as he'd grown up with an abusive father who struggled with alcoholism.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的童年充满了创伤，他在一个有酗酒问题的虐待狂父亲阴影下长大。

sentences.en: As the eldest child, Scott took on the role of protector, shielding his mother and siblings from his father's violent outbursts.
sentences.zh: 作为长子，斯科特承担起了保护者的角色，保护母亲和兄弟姐妹免受父亲暴力发作的伤害。

sentences.en: The turmoil at home led to him withdrawing from his peers.
sentences.zh: 家里的动荡导致他开始疏远同龄人。

sentences.en: During his adolescence, he also experienced occasional bed-wetting episodes, which amplified his feelings of shame and embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 在他的青春期，他还经历过间歇性的尿床，这加剧了他的羞耻感和尴尬感。

sentences.en: Despite this, Scott became, in the eyes of his mother Lois, every mother's dream of the perfect child.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，在母亲洛伊丝眼中，斯科特成了每个母亲梦寐以求的完美孩子。

sentences.en: He was incredibly helpful with his four younger siblings, highly intelligent, had a great sense of humour, and never displayed a temper.
sentences.zh: 他非常照顾四个年幼的弟妹，聪明过人，极具幽默感，从未发过脾气。

sentences.en: To Scott's family, nothing in his background indicated he would grow up to be a cold-blooded killer.
sentences.zh: 在斯科特的家人看来，他的背景中没有任何迹象表明他会成长为一个冷血杀手。

sentences.en: Then, one day, while discussing the case with their mother,
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，在与母亲讨论这起案件时，

sentences.en: Scott's sister Laura had a sudden realisation.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的妹妹劳拉突然顿悟。

sentences.en: A med school graduate and a writer for a medical website, she recalled a murder case from her studies that bore eerie similarities to what happened to Yamala.
sentences.zh: 作为医学院毕业生和医疗网站撰稿人，她回想起求学时的一起谋杀案，该案与雅玛拉的遭遇有着诡异的相似之处。

sentences.en: Early on the morning of Sunday, May 24, 1987,
sentences.zh: 那是1987年5月24日星期日的清晨，

sentences.en: 23-year-old electronics worker Kenneth Parks walked into a police station, appearing confused and asking for help.
sentences.zh: 23岁的电子厂工人肯尼斯·帕克斯走进了警察局，神情困惑并请求帮助。

sentences.en: He announced, I think I have killed some people.
sentences.zh: 他宣布，我想我杀了几个人。

sentences.en: Kenneth lived in Pickering, Canada with his wife and five-month-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯与妻子和五个月大的女儿住在加拿大皮克林。

sentences.en: He had been going through a difficult time lately.
sentences.zh: 他最近过得很艰难。

sentences.en: A gambling addiction had led to severe financial debt and, in desperation, he stole from his family's savings.
sentences.zh: 赌瘾导致他背负了沉重的财务债务，在绝望中，他偷了家里的积蓄。

sentences.en: He had also been fired after he was caught embezzling money from his workplace.
sentences.zh: 他还因为在工作场所贪污钱财被抓而被解雇。

sentences.en: That May,
sentences.zh: 那个五月，

sentences.en: Kenneth had been trying to overcome his addiction by attending Gambler's Anonymous meetings.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯一直通过参加戒赌互助会来克服瘾头。

sentences.en: He had come clean to his wife about his struggles and also planned to tell his in-laws,
sentences.zh: 他已经向妻子坦白了自己的困境，并计划在5月24日星期日那天也告诉岳父母，

sentences.en: Dennis and Barbara Woods, on Sunday, May 24.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯和芭芭拉·伍兹。

sentences.en: But that conversation never happened.
sentences.zh: 但那次对话从未发生。

sentences.en: Instead, sometime after 1.30 that morning,
sentences.zh: 相反，在那天凌晨1点30分之后的某个时间，

sentences.en: Kenneth drove 14 miles to his in-laws' home in Toronto.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯开车14英里来到了位于多伦多的岳父母家。

sentences.en: Using a key they had previously given him, he entered the house and went into their bedroom while they slept.
sentences.zh: 他用他们以前给他的钥匙进了屋，在他们睡觉时潜入了他们的卧室。

sentences.en: Armed with a tire iron, he brutally bludgeoned Barbara before stabbing her multiple times.
sentences.zh: 他带着一根撬胎棒，残忍地重击了芭芭拉，然后多次捅刺她。

sentences.en: He then attacked Dennis, choking him until he lost consciousness before stabbing him as well.
sentences.zh: 接着他袭击了丹尼斯，将其扼制至失去知觉，随后也捅了丹尼斯。

sentences.en: After the attack, still covered in blood,
sentences.zh: 袭击过后，身上仍沾满鲜血的

sentences.en: Kenneth got into his car and drove to a nearby police station where he immediately confessed.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯上车开往附近的一家警察局，并立即自首。

sentences.en: Dennis Woods survived the ordeal, but 42-year-old Barbara Woods succumbed to her injuries.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·伍兹在劫难逃中幸存下来，但42岁的芭芭拉·伍兹因伤势过重身亡。

sentences.en: Kenneth told police that before the attack, he had been watching television on his sofa at home.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯告诉警察，在袭击发生前，他正坐在家里的沙发上看电视。

sentences.en: At around 1.30 a.m., he fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨1点30分，他睡着了。

sentences.en: The next thing he remembered was standing inside his in-laws' house, covered in blood, with a knife in his hands.
sentences.zh: 他记下的下一件事就是自己站在岳父母的屋里，浑身是血，手里拿着一把刀。

sentences.en: Their beaten and bloodied bodies lay in front of him.
sentences.zh: 他们遭到殴打且血肉模糊的尸体躺在他面前。

sentences.en: Kenneth claimed to have no memory of the drive to their house or of carrying out the violence.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯声称自己完全不记得开车去他们家或实施暴力的过程。

sentences.en: He insisted he had no reason to harm Dennis or Barbara and expressed deep remorse for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己没有理由伤害丹尼斯或芭芭拉，并对发生的事情表达了深深的懊悔。

sentences.en: Over the course of seven police interviews, his story remained consistent.
sentences.zh: 在历经七次警方讯问的过程中，他的说法始终如一。

sentences.en: He never admitted to acting intentionally.
sentences.zh: 他从未承认自己是蓄意行凶。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, he was ultimately charged with Barbara's murder and the attempted murder of Dennis.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他最终还是被控谋杀芭芭拉以及企图谋杀丹尼斯。

sentences.en: At trial,
sentences.zh: 在审判中，

sentences.en: Kenneth's legal team presented an extraordinary theory that their client suffered from somnambulism, more commonly known as sleepwalking.
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯的法律团队提出了一个非同寻常的理论，即他们的当事人患有梦游症，更为人所知的是梦游。

sentences.en: They asserted that he had been in this state at the time of the attack, with no will or conscious mind directing him.
sentences.zh: 他们断言他在袭击发生时正处于这种状态，没有任何意志或有意识的心智在指挥他。

sentences.en: The defence cited
sentences.zh: 辩方列举了

sentences.en: 35 documented cases worldwide in which homicides were allegedly committed while the perpetrator was sleepwalking.
sentences.zh: 全球35起有据可查的案件，这些案件中凶手据称是在梦游时实施了杀戮。

sentences.en: One case from 1859
sentences.zh: 其中1859年的一起案件

sentences.en: involved a London woman who threw her infant son out of a window while screaming, save my children.
sentences.zh: 涉及一名伦敦妇女，她将自己的幼子从窗户扔了出去，同时尖叫着“救救我的孩子”。

sentences.en: She later claimed she had been dreaming that her house was on fire and believed she was rescuing him.

sentences.zh: 控方还提到了斯科特的说法，即他在袭击发生前的几个夜晚曾醒来，以为听到有入侵者潜伏在屋外。

sentences.zh: 控方还对斯科特所谓的梦游史提出了质疑。

sentences.zh: 他们计算出，从袭击开始到结束，斯科特总共执行了64个不同的动作，他们估计这个过程至少花了45分钟。

sentences.en: It was complex, with experts who held similar experience and qualifications arriving at starkly different conclusions.
sentences.zh: 案情错综复杂，有着相似经验和资历的专家们却得出了截然不同的结论。

sentences.en: In total, 52 witnesses were called and 180 court exhibits were entered into evidence.
sentences.zh: 总共有52名证人出庭作证，180件法庭呈物被作为证据提交。

sentences.en: In closing arguments, the defence reiterated that Scott was a non-violent person who'd had a wonderful marriage.
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，辩方重申斯科特是一个从不暴力且拥有美满婚姻的人。

sentences.en: They emphasised that there was simply no motive for Scott to willfully kill Yamala.
sentences.zh: 他们强调，斯科特根本没有任何动机去蓄意杀害亚马拉。

sentences.en: The prosecution focused on the drowning aspect of the crime, stating,
sentences.zh: 控方将焦点放在了犯罪的溺水情节上，并表示：

sentences.en: Scott for later cannot get away from, is the fact that when Yamala was down, he did a violent act.
sentences.zh: 斯科特以后也无法回避，那就是当亚马拉倒下时，他实施了暴力行为。

sentences.en: Never in the annals of sleepwalking has there ever been a case where two different types of lethal violence have been applied in one case.
sentences.zh: 在梦游的历史上，从来没有一个案件在同一案件中出现过两种不同类型的致命暴力。

sentences.en: While the prosecution acknowledged that no one but Scott truly knew what happened that night, they confidently declared,
sentences.zh: 虽然控方承认，除了斯科特之外没有人真正知道那天晚上发生了什么，但他们自信地宣称：

sentences.en: This guy here killed his wife, and he's guilty of first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 这家伙杀了自己的妻子，他犯下了谋杀罪。

sentences.en: It took the jury just eight hours to reach a verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团仅用了八个小时就达成了一项裁决。

sentences.en: Ultimately, they found the prosecution's experts more compelling than those of the defence.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们发现控方的专家比辩方的专家更有说服力。

sentences.en: For the first-degree murder of Yamala for later, Scott for later was found guilty.
sentences.zh: 因谋杀亚马拉，斯科特被判有罪。

sentences.zh: 亚马拉时正处于梦游状态。

sentences.en: However, they believed that he regained consciousness and panicked afterward.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们相信他随后恢复了意识并惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Despite the inconclusive evidence, the jury was certain that Yamala was still alive when Scott pushed her into the pool.
sentences.zh: 尽管证据不确凿，但陪审团坚信，当斯科特将亚马拉推入泳池时，她还活着。

sentences.en: They agreed that he had premeditated the decision to drown her and was fully cognizant while carrying out the act.
sentences.zh: 他们一致认为，他预谋了将她溺死的决定，并且在实施这一行为时完全清醒。

sentences.en: A significant portion of the jury's deliberations centered on
sentences.zh: 陪审团审议的很大一部分集中在

sentences.zh: 斯科特使用的狩猎刀，一名陪审员表示，这种物品除了杀人之外没有其他用途。

sentences.en: While the prosecution pushed for the death penalty, the sentencing hearing, which took place a year after the guilty verdict, saw multiple character witnesses testify

sentences.en: positively on Scott's behalf.

sentences.zh: 她承认，尽管他应该受到严厉的惩罚，但他的孩子不应该失去母亲和父亲。

sentences.en: During sentencing, the judge remarked,
sentences.zh: 在宣判时，法官评论道：

sentences.en: Yamala was a woman we all would have liked to know.
sentences.zh: 亚马拉是我们所有人都想结识的女性。

sentences.zh: 她独立、好强、全心全意地奉献给她的孩子，而且是一个不会轻信一切的人，因为她有自己的思想。

sentences.en: But because of the defendant's cruel attack on her, she did not get to see her daughter graduate as a valedictorian of her class.
sentences.zh: 但由于被告对她残忍的袭击，她没能看到女儿作为班级毕业生代表在毕业典礼上致辞。

sentences.en: Did not get to see her son grow into the fine young man and good athlete that he is.
sentences.zh: 没能看到儿子成长为一个优秀的年轻人和出色的运动员。

sentences.en: Did not get to share in the joy of her daughter attending one of the finest universities in the country.
sentences.zh: 没能分享女儿进入全国最好的大学之一的喜悦。

sentences.en: And did not get to pursue her own return to teaching.
sentences.zh: 也没能继续她重返教师岗位的追求。

sentences.en: She also won't have the opportunity to enjoy any grandchildren she might have had.
sentences.zh: 她也没有机会享受她本可能拥有的任何孙辈。

sentences.zh: 法官还承认斯科特没有犯罪记录，表现出极大的悔意，并且是一个对他人产生积极影响的模范犯人。

sentences.en: However, he also recognized that the murder was especially cruel and heinous.
sentences.zh: 然而，他也认识到这起谋杀案极其残忍和令人发指。

sentences.en: As a result, Scott for later was sentenced to life imprisonment without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 因此，斯科特被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: At the time of this episode's release, Scott remains in prison where he practices meditation and ensures he gets adequate sleep.
sentences.zh: 在本集发布时，斯科特仍在狱中服刑，在那里他练习冥想并确保自己获得充足的睡眠。

sentences.en: Over the years, he has received letters of support from other sleepwalkers whom he encourages to seek treatment to prevent a similar incident from occurring.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他收到了来自其他梦游者的支持信，他鼓励他们寻求治疗以防止类似事件再次发生。

sentences.en: He remains to be a model inmate, known for assisting, teaching, and providing spiritual guidance to other inmates and helping prison staff with technology probleMs.

sentences.en: Scott stays in touch with his two children, with his son
sentences.zh: 斯科特与他的两个孩子保持着联系，他的儿子

sentences.zh: 他依然是我的父亲，我希望无论他是在监狱里还是出来，我都能与他保持联系。

sentences.en: However, Scott himself doubts he will ever be released.
sentences.zh: 然而，斯科特本人怀疑他是否能被释放。

sentences.zh: 多次试图对他的刑罚提出上诉均告失败。

sentences.zh: 该案的核心问题从未令所有人满意地解决。

sentences.en: As Scott's mother,
sentences.zh: 正如斯科特的母亲

sentences.en: Lois, stated,
sentences.zh: 洛伊丝所说：

sentences.en: He's technically guilty, but he's morally innocent.
sentences.zh: 他在技术上有罪，但在道义上是无辜的。

sentences.en: He was there, and he wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里，又不在那里。

sentences.en: Scott's story elicits its fair share of critics and sceptics.
sentences.zh: 斯科特的故事引来了相当多的批评者和怀疑论者。

sentences.en: While sleepwalking is a widely accepted phenomenon, some have expressed concern that if Scott were acquitted, sleepwalking might become an excuse for any crime.
sentences.zh: 虽然梦游是一个被广泛接受的现象，但一些人表示担忧，如果斯科特被判无罪，梦游可能会成为任何犯罪的借口。

sentences.en: Others view the use of a sleepwalking defence as nothing more than junk science, suggesting that attorneys just pay experts to offer whatever testimony is necessary

sentences.en: to protect their client's interests.

sentences.zh: 斯科特坚称，在他的案件中，陪审团弄错了。

sentences.en: He insists that he is not a monster and believes his verdict was influenced by the complexity of sleep disorders, a still evolving field that is not yet fully understood.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己不是一个怪物，并认为他的裁决受到睡眠障碍复杂性的影响，这是一个仍在发展中且尚未被完全理解的领域。

sentences.en: Scott has expressed a doubt that he will ever forgive himself for killing

sentences.en: Yamala.

sentences.en: He believes they were meant for each other and has stated that he will miss her until the day he dies.
sentences.zh: 他相信他们是天生的一对，并表示他会怀念她直到他死去的那一天。

sentences.en: He often reflects on the pain and terror
sentences.zh: 他经常回想痛苦和恐惧

sentences.en: Yamala must have felt when he attacked her and is grateful that he does not have any memories of what he did to her that night.
sentences.zh: 亚马拉在他袭击她时一定感受到了，并且庆幸自己不记得那天晚上他对她做了什么。

sentences.en: I kind of wish she had grabbed the knife and done me instead, he said.
sentences.zh: 我甚至希望她当时抓住那把刀把我捅了，他说。

sentences.zh: 但因为那是我，她没有这么做。

sentences.en: Scott feels that Yamala would have been more understanding and forgiving of him than he had been towards himself and expresses hope that they will be reunited in heaven, saying,
sentences.zh: 斯科特觉得亚马拉会比他对自己更加理解和宽容，并表达了他们将在天堂重聚的希望，说道：

sentences.zh: 她比我更清楚那天晚上发生了什么，她实际上会知道我自那以后是如何行事的。
